positive_yogas.name: Ruchaka Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Mars exalted (Aries/Capricorn) or in own sign (Aries/Scorpio) in a kendra (1,4,7,10)
positive_yogas.effect: Great courage, military prowess, leadership abilities, victory over enemies, strong physique

positive_yogas.name: Bhadra Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Mercury exalted (Virgo) or in own sign (Gemini/Virgo) in a kendra
positive_yogas.effect: Exceptional intelligence, business acumen, eloquence, mastery in arts and sciences

positive_yogas.name: Hamsa Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Jupiter exalted (Cancer) or in own sign (Sagittarius/Pisces) in a kendra
positive_yogas.effect: Spiritual wisdom, virtuous character, wealth, respect, divine grace, teacher qualities

positive_yogas.name: Malavya Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Venus exalted (Pisces) or in own sign (Taurus/Libra) in a kendra
positive_yogas.effect: Exceptional beauty, artistic talent, luxurious life, vehicles, happy marriage, refined tastes

positive_yogas.name: Sasha Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Saturn exalted (Libra) or in own sign (Capricorn/Aquarius) in a kendra
positive_yogas.effect: Authority over others, disciplined success, longevity, property, servant leadership

positive_yogas.name: Gaja Kesari Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Jupiter in kendra (1,4,7,10) from Moon
positive_yogas.effect: Great mental strength, wisdom, wealth, fame, optimistic outlook, ability to overcome depression

positive_yogas.name: Saraswati Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury together or individually in 1,2,4,5,7,9,10 houses
positive_yogas.effect: Artistic intelligence, creativity, mastery in music/arts, balanced mental approach, eloquence

positive_yogas.name: Amala Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Benefics (Jupiter/Venus/Mercury) in 10th house from Moon or Ascendant
positive_yogas.effect: Purity of character, professional integrity, mental peace through career success, lasting fame

positive_yogas.name: Budhaditya Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Sun and Mercury conjunct in the same house
positive_yogas.effect: Sharp intellect, administrative skills, logical thinking, success in government/education

positive_yogas.name: Chandra Mangala Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Moon and Mars conjunct
positive_yogas.effect: Wealth accumulation, property gains, enterprising nature, mother's support in wealth

positive_yogas.name: Lakshmi Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Venus strong and lord of 9th house well-placed in kendra/trikona
positive_yogas.effect: Abundance of wealth, luxuries, comforts, divine grace of Goddess Lakshmi, prosperity

positive_yogas.name: Sunapha Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Planet (except Sun) in 2nd house from Moon
positive_yogas.effect: Self-made wealth, intelligence, good reputation, prosperity after initial struggles

positive_yogas.name: Anapha Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Planet (except Sun) in 12th house from Moon
positive_yogas.effect: Good health, beauty, fame, moral character, generous nature, spiritual inclination

positive_yogas.name: Durudhara Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Planets (except Sun) in both 2nd and 12th from Moon
positive_yogas.effect: Wealth from multiple sources, vehicles, respect, balanced personality, worldly comforts

positive_yogas.name: Vesi Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Planet (except Moon) in 2nd house from Sun
positive_yogas.effect: Hard worker, balanced speech, wealth through efforts, respected in society

positive_yogas.name: Voshi Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Planet (except Moon) in 12th house from Sun
positive_yogas.effect: Technical skills, strategic thinking, success through innovation, independent wealth

positive_yogas.name: Ubhayachari Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Planets (except Moon) in both 2nd and 12th from Sun
positive_yogas.effect: Royal treatment, authority, wealth, many talents, success in life, balanced approach

positive_yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga - Type 1
positive_yogas.condition: Debilitated planet's dispositor in kendra from Ascendant or Moon
positive_yogas.effect: Reversal of misfortune, late success, strength from weakness, resilience

positive_yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga - Type 2
positive_yogas.condition: Debilitated planet aspected by its dispositor
positive_yogas.effect: Hidden talents emerge, success after struggles, transformation of weakness

positive_yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga - Type 3
positive_yogas.condition: Debilitated planet with exalted planet in kendra
positive_yogas.effect: Cancellation of debilitation, turning point in life, achieving despite odds

positive_yogas.name: Adhi Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Benefics (Jupiter/Venus/Mercury) in 6th, 7th, and 8th houses from Moon
positive_yogas.effect: Long life, health, wealth, authority, victory over enemies, ministerial position

positive_yogas.name: Chamara Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Exalted lagna lord in kendra, aspected by Jupiter
positive_yogas.effect: Born leader, scholarly abilities, long life, fame comparable to royalty

positive_yogas.name: Shankha Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: 5th and 6th lords in mutual kendras, lagna lord strong
positive_yogas.effect: Compassionate nature, virtuous, wealthy, intelligent children, long life

positive_yogas.name: Bheri Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Venus, Jupiter, and lagna lord in mutual kendras
positive_yogas.effect: Healthy body, long life, luxurious comforts, happy family, success

positive_yogas.name: Mridanga Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Lagna lord exalted/own sign, planets in 2nd and 12th houses
positive_yogas.effect: Wealth, virtuous character, happiness, good family, respected position

positive_yogas.name: Parijata Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Lagna lord in kendra/trikona/exalted with dispositor in kendra/trikona
positive_yogas.effect: Happiness in middle age, charitable, kind-hearted, respectable status

positive_yogas.name: Kahala Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: 4th and 9th lords in mutual kendras, lagna lord strong
positive_yogas.effect: Courageous, bold, leader, commander qualities, wealthy, stubborn

positive_yogas.name: Vasumati Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Benefics in upachaya houses (3,6,10,11) from Ascendant or Moon
positive_yogas.effect: Accumulation of wealth, property, prosperity increases with age

positive_yogas.name: Parvata Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Benefics in  kendras, no malefics in kendras, lagna/Moon lord strong
positive_yogas.effect: Famous, wealthy, generous, charitable, learned, long-lived

positive_yogas.name: Pushkala Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Lagna lord exalted, Moon in own/friendly sign, Jupiter in kendra
positive_yogas.effect: Scholarly, wealthy, good speech, generous, respected by rulers

positive_yogas.name: Akhanda Samrajya Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Jupiter in 2nd/5th/11th, lagna lord strong, no malefics in kendras
positive_yogas.effect: Unbroken empire, lasting authority, righteous ruler, prosperity for generations

positive_yogas.name: Chatussagara Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: All kendras occupied by planets, no malefic influence
positive_yogas.effect: Rulership qualities, universal respect, righteous character, lasting legacy

positive_yogas.name: Kusuma Yoga

positive_yogas.effect: Authority like a king, well-versed in scriptures, sweet speech, charitable

positive_yogas.name: Matsya Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Malefics in 1st and 9th, benefics in 4th and 10th OR vice versa
positive_yogas.effect: Charitable nature, righteous conduct, attracted to water, virtuous, happy

positive_yogas.name: Kurma Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Benefics in 5th, 6th, 7th houses and exaltation signs occupied/aspected
positive_yogas.effect: Patient like tortoise, long life, famous, virtuous, wealthy

positive_yogas.name: Khadga Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: 2nd lord in 9th, 9th lord in 2nd with lagna lord in kendra/trikona

positive_yogas.name: Lakshana Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: Lagna lord strong, 9th lord in swakshetra/exalted, Jupiter aspecting
positive_yogas.effect: Attractive personality, virtuous character, knowledgeable, respected

positive_yogas.name: Harsha Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: 6th lord in 6th house
positive_yogas.effect: Victory over enemies, good health, fearless, prosperous, happy

positive_yogas.name: Sarala Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: 8th lord in 8th house
positive_yogas.effect: Long life, fearless, prosperous, wise, learned, free from diseases

positive_yogas.name: Vimala Yoga
positive_yogas.condition: 12th lord in 12th house
positive_yogas.effect: Frugal, happy, independent, good character, spiritual inclination
